title: CRUD Operations and Transactions
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of crud operations and transactions in a Ruby program and name the key rule involved.
Apply crud operations and transactions in a small example and predict its result before running it.
Identify one boundary or failure case related to rollback and consistency and verify the intended behavior.

content.intro: Learn CRUD Operations and Transactions through a visual model, a minimal Ruby example, and a practical check.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding crud operations and transactions helps you write code that is easier to explain, test, and maintain. It also helps separate Ruby language guarantees from runtime assumptions, dependency behavior, and application-specific rules.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: CRUD Operations and Transactions helps you reason about creating and reading records. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: How to think about it
content_blocks.text: Begin by identifying the key rule: Creating and reading records. Then connect it to Updating and deleting data. The remaining syllabus points—Transaction boundaries, Rollback and consistency—are useful checks before applying this in a larger project.

content_blocks.title: Example: CRUD Operations and Transactions
content_blocks.code:
require "sqlite3"
db = SQLite3::Database.new(":memory:")
db.execute("CREATE TABLE stock (sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY, quantity INTEGER)")
db.transaction { db.execute("INSERT INTO stock VALUES (?, ?)", ["PEN", 3]) }
puts db.get_first_value("SELECT quantity FROM stock WHERE sku = ?", "PEN")
db.close
